channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Bantry and Schull Get Connected as High-Speed Fibre Broadband Goes Live
item.description: Nearly 6,200 homes and businesses near Bantry and Schull can now order high-speed fibre broadband under the National Broadband Plan.

item.title: Cork City Council Employee Dan Fox to Represent Ireland at Gymnastics World Cup
item.description: Cork's Dan Fox heads to Baku and Antalya next month to represent Ireland at the FIG Apparatus World Cup, with Olympic qualification on the line.

item.title: Breakdown on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Jack Lynch Tunnel West Entrance and Jack Lynch Tunnel East Entrance (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 27 February at 12:41.

item.title: Collision on Tramore Road
item.description: Reports of a collision on Tramore Road near the junction with Kent Road. Take care on approach.

item.title: E-Scooter on N25 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of an E-scooter on the N25 eastbound, just east of the Midleton R630 exit. Take extrem care on approach.

item.title: Uisce Éireann to Replace Ageing Water Mains in Codrum, Macroom
item.description: Uisce Éireann begins water main replacement works in Codrum, Macroom next week to improve supply reliability for local homes and businesses.

item.title: Collision on Blarney Road
item.description: Reports of a collision on Blarney Road near the junction with Lower Killeen’s Road. Take care on approach.

item.title: Multi-vehicle Collision on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a multi-vehicle collision, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 9 (N28) Ringaskiddy and Junction 10 Mahon (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 27 February at 16:54.

item.title: Record February Trolley Crisis as Nearly 12,000 Patients Go Without Hospital Beds
item.description: Nearly 12,000 patients went without a hospital bed in Ireland this February, the worst on record, with Cork University Hospital among the top five most overcrowded in the country.
